clues.text: Listening at the tent entrance, she laughed to herself when the LORD said she would have a son in old age.
God told Abraham that his wife would no longer go by her old name but would be given a new one.
In Gerar, Abraham called his wife his sister, so King Abimelech had her brought to him.
She told Abraham to drive out Hagar and her son, so that boy would not share the inheritance.
As God had promised, she conceived and bore Isaac to Abraham in his old age.
Abraham's wife lived to be 127 years old and died at Hebron in the land of Canaan.
Peter held her up to wives as one who obeyed Abraham and called him lord.
